ValidationRule.description: A Done task is frozen (hours, project) and can only be reopened to In Progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Done'), OR( ISCHANGED(Estimated_Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Actual_Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Project__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'In Progress'))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Done tasks are locked; reopen to In Progress first.
